title: notification.automation.task_requested
description: An Engage automation reached a create_task step. Nothing in this platform creates the task yet: a task-owning service (projects, pulseboard, support) subscribes to this key and decides what a task is. `run_id` plus `node_id` identify the request uniquely, so a consumer that receives it twice can drop the second.

source_event_id.description: The event that started the run.
